title: Mixed Event — Scramble Fan Festival! — Episode9 Be Yourself and Smile

meta.Event Outline: Minori, Ichika, Kohane and Nene are all set to sing in the annual VIRTUAL SINGER Fan Festival. Kanade and the rest of N25 also attend, keen to witness their favorite creators. The curtains rise, uniting heartfelt emotions into a grand symphony!

rows.Line: Fan Festival Stage

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: It should be Azusawa's turn soon.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Kohane...!

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
Whoa, she's really cute.
Is she singing by herself?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: She seems pretty nervous. You think she's gonna be okay?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (I can do this. An's out there cheering for me... I just need to sing!)
song00001_off_f

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: She's good! Like, really good!

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Yeah, talk about a nice surprise...!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: That's Azusawa for you...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Yeah, this should be a walk in the park for her.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Because she's the best!
She sounds even better than she did during practice!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Whoa, Ichi's doing awesome!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: It's nice to just watch from the audience like this since we're always playing together.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: I know, right?! She doesn't seem nervous at all! She's just singing her heart out...!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Hehe. It must be because you went to talk to her, Shiho.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: I didn't really tell her much...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
I've heard that voice before...
When the cherry blossoms were blooming...

rows.Speaker: Audience
rows.Line: Such a beautiful voice...

rows.Speaker: Audience
rows.Line: It's so heartwarming...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Look, everyone's waving their arms as Nene sings!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: That's our songstress for you!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Hehe. Is that a tear I see in your eye, Tsukasa?

rows.Speaker: MC
rows.Line: We're getting really great performances from everyone today! I'm sure you'll all agree with me on that!

rows.Speaker: MC
rows.Line: Next, give it up for Minori Hanasato! Come on up!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Hey, Minori's up next!

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Oh, she's the one from Airi's group. This should be good...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: H-Hello, everyone! My name is Minori Hanasato! I'd like to sing you all a Miku song and give you the best performance I can today!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Yikes, she sounds way too nervous...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: You can do it, Minori...!

rows.Speaker: Audience
rows.Line: What do you think she's gonna sing...?

rows.Speaker: Audience
rows.Line: Dunno, but she seems super nervous... I hope she's okay...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
(So many people...!
They're all looking at me...!)

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: (Oh no, I'm getting scared... But...!)

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: (I worked so hard to get here today. I need to spread hope to everyone!)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
Oh no...!
Minori!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
(No, what do I do...?!
I'm completely out of rhythm...!)

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: (Even after Haruka tried to cheer me up...)

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: (Am I just not cut out for doing this alone...?)

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: I admit it's natural to feel a little nervous about going up there.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: However, if you succeed, you'll be able to inspire hope in all these people!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: You may be going on stage alone today, but you aren't actually alone. We'll be there to cheer you on.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: So whatever happens, you'll be fine. Just keep smiling like you always do, Minori.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: (Right. I just need to keep smiling, and I should be able to inspire hope in everyone!)

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: (I have the rest of the song to make up for my mistakes!)

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
(Listen carefully, keep facing forward...
And sing so your voice reaches everyone!)

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Whoa, she just...!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Turned everything around...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Yeah. Looks like what we practiced is paying off.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: (Exaggerate each move for the dance sequence...)

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: (Stay focused. Make each move count, including what each finger does!)

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Wow, look!
Minori's so super duper sparkly now!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: All thanks to my advice to her!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: We should expect no less from an idol...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: So bright...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: She's gotten so much better at dancing compared to when I last saw her during a stream...!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Yeah, she looked pretty nervous at first, but she's doing awesome now! I kinda can't help but root for her!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Did Minori just gain another level just now?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Hehe. It really is hard to look away from her.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: (You can tell just how hard she worked to get here.)

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: I'm sure of it, Minori...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: You're going to blossom into something incredible.

rows.Speaker: Announcement
rows.Line: <That concludes today's Fan Festival. Please be sure to not forget any belongings when leaving.>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Phew...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: (The quality of every performance was so high.)

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: (It was nice to hear music from different genres too.)

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Like peering into a whole new world...
